title: International Training Program in Sleep Medicine
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Eligibility: Internists (Board in Internal Medicine), neurologists and pulmonologists
International applicants: Yes - international training programme run through the School of Global Health
Application method: Apply directly to the School of Global Health (school.global.health@chula.md) with a supporting letter from the affiliated institution; selection by resume and interview
Funding: No tuition fee is charged; the accepted candidate must register at Chulalongkorn University
Summary: International training programme giving trainees comprehensive knowledge of the diagnosis and treatment of adult and paediatric sleep disorders, including polysomnography interpretation and a clinical research project.

title: International Training Program in Interventional Pulmonology
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Department: Division of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine (Santiwan Respiratory Center)
Eligibility: Medical degree with board certification in internal medicine and subspecialty certification in pulmonary medicine; supporting letter from affiliated institution
International applicants: Yes - successful candidates from abroad must submit a health certificate and proof of adequate health insurance
Application method: Apply directly to the School of Global Health (school.global.health@chula.md) with a supporting letter from the affiliated institution; selection by resume and interview
Funding: Fee charged to cover registration and tuition (SGH training courses); applicants from economically developing countries may request partial or full scholarship
Summary: Training for pulmonologists in diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy (EBUS, rigid bronchoscopy, stents, thermoplasty), medical thoracoscopy and pleural procedures at the Santiwan Respiratory Center.

title: Clinical Fellowship Training Program in Craniofacial Surgery
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Department: Craniofacial Center / Division of Plastic Surgery
Eligibility: Completed residency training in plastic surgery or oral and maxillofacial surgery
International applicants: Yes - offered through the School of Global Health to international trainees
Application method: Apply to the School of Global Health or email craniofacial@chula.md
Funding: Fee charged to cover registration and tuition (SGH training courses); applicants from economically developing countries may request partial or full scholarship
Summary: One-year hands-on fellowship following the ISCFS curriculum in congenital anomalies, maxillofacial injuries, craniofacial oncology and cosmetic craniofacial surgery, with a required research study.

title: Colorectal Fellowship Program
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Department: Colorectal Surgery Unit, Department of Surgery
Eligibility: Healthcare professionals interested in specialising in colorectal surgery and managing complex anal fistula and pelvic floor disorders
International applicants: Yes - offered through the School of Global Health to international trainees
Application method: Apply to the School of Global Health or email ccruchula@gmail.com with qualifications, experience and a statement of intent
Funding: Fee charged to cover registration and tuition (SGH training courses); applicants from economically developing countries may request partial or full scholarship
Summary: Training in supraradical pelvic surgery for advanced rectal cancer (including minimally invasive approaches), complex fistula-in-ano surgery and ventral rectopexy.

title: Endoscopic Sinus and Skull Base Surgery Fellowship Training
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Department: Department of Otolaryngology / Endoscopic Nasal and Sinus Surgery Excellence Center
Eligibility: Medical degree with board certification in Otolaryngology; experienced sinus and skull base surgeons; supporting letter from affiliated institution
International applicants: Yes - successful candidates from abroad need a health certificate and proof of health insurance
Application method: Apply directly to the School of Global Health (school.global.health@chula.md) with a supporting letter from the affiliated institution; selection by resume and interview
Funding: A fee is charged for the 6-month training
Summary: Six-month training in advanced endoscopic sinus and skull base surgery with cadaver lab and supervised surgery on patients.

title: Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) International Training Program
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Department: Division of Gastroenterology, Department of Medicine
Eligibility: Medical degree with board certification in internal medicine/gastroenterology or surgery, working in an academic institution or public hospital, able to pass a side-viewing duodenoscope
International applicants: Yes - successful candidates from abroad need a health certificate and proof of health insurance
Application method: Apply directly to the School of Global Health (school.global.health@chula.md) with a supporting letter from the affiliated institution; selection by resume and interview
Funding: Fee charged for registration and tuition (EUS training and Gastrointestinal Endoscopy 2 course)
Summary: Six-month hands-on diagnostic and therapeutic EUS training on in-vivo models and patients under expert supervision, with participation in clinical studies.

title: Postgraduate Observership for International Visitors
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Chulalongkorn University / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
Eligibility: Postgraduate visitors; CV, letter of intent, recommendation letter from Dean/Vice Dean/Supervisor, passport, immunisation record
International applicants: Yes - for international visitors; reviewed by International Affairs and the host department (4-6 weeks)
Application method: Submit application checklist to MDCU International Affairs (chulamed.international@gmail.com)
Funding: Fee required based on each subspecialty; MOU institutions may receive discount or waiver
Visa support: Visitor must obtain a relevant visa; responsible for travel, immigration, accommodation, living costs and insurance
Summary: Observership for postgraduate international visitors at King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital across clinical departments.
